skill_name: Given a news article, summarize the main points in less than 100 words?
workflow: Monday marks the commencement of a trial for Otto Warmbier, an American college student detained in North Korea for more than a year. His parents Fred and Cindy have been actively campaigning for his release. The court case offers a chance to end this long-running conflict between the US and North Korea. Additionally, it could provide Otto's family closure after such a difficult situation.
